reuse.why: All providers use the shared link guard and existing bank lookup, but Fintegra copies provider workflows and replacement duplicates the existing unlink field reset.

duplication.why: The diff adds three duplicated blocks: the provider linking workflow, transaction download workflow, and local unlink reset.

placement.why: Provider handlers, downloads, configuration, and types follow existing layers, although a mutating unlink operation is hidden inside an assertion helper.

scope.why: The changes stay focused on the requested linking policies and server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Centralized link checks simplify policy updates, but copied provider workflows and an assertion that now mutates accounts create avoidable maintenance obligations.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere duplicates unlinkAccount's local field reset instead of extracting a shared local unlink operation that both paths can use without provider contact.

disguised_duplication.where: The Fintegra linking and download implementations and replacement unlink reset are direct copies with substitutions, rather than structurally disguised duplication.

abstraction_drift.where: Across the requested steps, assertNotLinkedElsewhere gains replaceExistingLink, closed-target rejection, and replacement handling with account mutations; all six provider link handlers still call it.
